description_en: Modifies the information of an IPv6 gateway
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-ipv6-gateway-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipv6-gateway-id ipv6gw-hp39kh1ya51yzp2lu0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyIpv6GatewayAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the IPv6 gateway. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: IPv6网关的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPv6 gateway to modify
parameters.name: ipv6_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IPv6 gateway.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6网关的名称。

长度为0-128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the IPv6 gateway.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6网关的描述信息。

长度为0-256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system does not associate a prefix list with a route table. The system checks the AccessKey pair, the authorization of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and the required parameters. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.

false (default): sends a Normal request. After the check succeeds, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the routing table is associated
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会关联路由表。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并关联路由表
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
